synopsis.text: Tony Stark creates a cerebral scanner that will determine Hank Pym’s innocence. Jennifer Walters reverts back to She-Hulk after a heated argument with Hawkeye. Plus, the Avengers witness Hank Pym’s single-handed victory over the Masters of Evil!

Henry Pym just can't catch a break! During his testimony last issue, the Masters of Evil stormed the courtroom and kidnapped him! Now the brilliant biochemist is holed up in Egghead's secret headquarters reluctantly working on a new project for his long-time enemy. Meanwhile at Avengers Mansion, frustration is building in the ranks! Iron Man is missing, She-Hulk has been de-powered, and nobody knows where the Masters of Evil took Hank! But with some outside the box thinking, the Avengers' ace archer and the team's newest member reverse the momentum! Can Earth's Mightiest Heroes rescue Hank Pym in time?
